notes.title: Working on Build 9, livestream
notes.content:
Hey All,

[h1][b]Blog[/b][/h1]

It's been a hot minute since the last update, been churning through a variety of game prototypes over the past several months. Time to get back into CS and spruce the game up a bit!

I'm going to try and put the game out on mobile as well, and I wanted to add some more variety/randomness to the maps and surges before that. As a nice side effect, the game will be playable on touch screens, and there will be some more UI that can be turned on for PC if y'all want to see the progress till abilities come off cooldown.

Tune into the stream on Wednesday, Jan 15th, at 2pm (-5 GMT; EST) to hangout and see how the sauce is made.

notes.title: Build 8 and What's Next
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

[h1][b]Blog[/b][/h1]
Added in a new minimap function that's unlocked after you reach the first boss.

Also, I'd like to take the time to clear up the future of CS. The game is for all intents and purposes done. For those of you that have reached the end, that's the teaser for the sequel, which is currently in the design stage.

Some changes, like more difficulty modes, might happen down the line. If you think there's a feature that might make the game better, feel free to post on the discord. That, and reviews, is how the minimap feature came about.

That being said, most work is currently going into another two games, and the preliminary work for the CS sequel. (Yes, solo dev, but this is how I work X) )

Now, on to the main show:

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Far Sight ability, unlocked after reaching the first boss
[*] Added abilities to speed up inner/outer transition, these are in the same pedestal as Far Sight
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed cases where Relentless Aggression can get stuck underneath the map
[*] Expanded the collider on all pedestals, should make it easier to trigger them now, even with armor
[/list]

notes.title: Build 7
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

[h1][b]Blog[/b][/h1]
Quick bug fix and quality of life update.

Will be working on adding a minimap soon, by popular request.

Also, had some issues with a plugin and our version control, please post on the discord if any new....weird/unexpected interactions or bugs happen.

Now, on to the main show:

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added ~cinematic~ camera zoom out when reaching a new tier for Inner upgrades
[*] Boss Surges can now only roll Rare adapt cards
[*] Every 5th Surge can only roll uncommon or better adapt cards
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Cascade sound not stopping, if Cascade was running when player died
[*] Removed Outer pedestal collider, should be much easier to start Surges now
[*] Minor UI fixes for consistency
[/list]
